description:
This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal proposals or quotes. Solicitation, 36C24626Q0379, will be issued on or about 13 March 2026. The Department of Veterans Affairs, Salisbury VAMC, Charlotte HCC, and Kernersville HCC has a requirement for a Custom Surgical Packs.
This acquisition is being solicited Unrestricted on the open market. The applicable NAICS Code is 339113 with a size standard of 800 Employees. All correspondence and responses shall be via e-mail to Aleshia.Hines-Best@va.gov. Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted.
